insights.one_liner: Hilti Nederland is the Dutch arm of a 32,000-person construction tools company, based in Berkel en Rodenrijs and an IND visa sponsor.

culture.text: Dutch office of Hilti, which has over 32,000 employees worldwide making tools, software and services for construction sites.
About 370 people in the Netherlands, mostly in sales and operations; staff often studied at Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences, Erasmus, Avans or TU Delft.
Its company texts are written in Dutch and name integrity, courage, teamwork and commitment as its values.

open.text: Hilti Nederland B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a hardware and engineering role in Berkel en Rodenrijs, doesn't require Dutch.
